BREAKFAST
Aug 2024 • Friends
Happy Heart in Da Nang is a delightful breakfast spot that offers a diverse range of options to start your day right. From classic American favorites to local twists, this cozy café delivers a satisfying breakfast experience.

Happy Heart’s interior is warm and inviting, with a blend of modern comfort and Vietnamese charm. The bright and airy space, complemented by cheerful décor, creates a relaxing environment perfect for enjoying a leisurely breakfast. 

The staff are friendly and attentive, contributing to the café’s welcoming atmosphere. 

We ordered below food;

Chicken Quesadilla The quesadilla is a flavorful choice, featuring well-seasoned chicken with a good melt of cheese. The tortilla is crispy on the outside while remaining soft inside, and it’s served with a side of salsa and sour cream that enhance the overall taste.

Grilled Cheese: A comfort food classic, the grilled cheese at Happy Heart hits all the right notes. The bread is perfectly toasted, with a generous layer of melted cheese that’s both gooey and satisfying. It’s a simple yet delicious option for those who enjoy straightforward, well-executed comfort food.

Bagel: The bagel is fresh. It’s a great choice for a lighter breakfast or if you’re in the mood for something simple. Paired with cream cheese and perhaps a slice of smoked salmon, it’s a satisfying start to the day.

Pancakes with Fruit: The pancakes are fluffy and golden brown, served with a colorful assortment of fresh fruit. The fruit topping adds a burst of freshness and a natural sweetness that complements the pancakes perfectly. It’s a great option for those who enjoy a sweeter breakfast.

American Breakfast: The American breakfast plate is hearty and satisfying, featuring classic items like eggs cooked to your preference, crispy bacon, and golden hash browns. It’s a well-rounded meal that offers a comforting taste of home.

If you're looking for a cream cheese cake there, you’re in for a treat! 

The prices are reasonable considering the quality and portion sizes of the dishes. It’s an excellent choice for a filling breakfast that won’t break the bank.

Happy Heart in Da Nang excels in providing a diverse breakfast menu that caters to various tastes. Whether you’re in the mood for a hearty American breakfast or a simple grilled cheese, this café delivers with both flavor and quality. It’s a great spot to enjoy a relaxing breakfast and start your day on a positive note.
